units.source_text: 友子在马车厢里摇了摇合上的阳伞。

en.t: Tomoko gave her closed parasol a little shake inside the carriage.

units.source_text: 她那把阳伞的伞尖，活像公共马车别致的小尾巴，

en.t: The tip of her parasol looked just like a stylish little tail on the public carriage,

units.source_text: 也许她是在和着舞蹈曲子《竹苑中》的旋律摇荡吧。

en.t: perhaps she was swaying it in time with the melody of the dance tune Bamboo Garden.
